opportunities.exact_claim: For every finite d, every legal symmetric two-output broadcaster B with marginal Phi, and every positive frame Q on traceless Hermitians, there exists one POVM M_Q on the joint local output family Omega_theta=B((I+sum_i theta_i A_i)/d) whose classical Fisher-information trace at theta=0 is at least V(Q)-C0[V(Q)-s_Phi(Q)], with C0 independent of d and frame rank. Pullback through B gives V(Q)-k(Q)<=C0[V(Q)-s_Phi(Q)] for all Q; cone separation then yields one common EB Psi independent of Q.
opportunities.mechanism: At the tracial point I/d the SLDs are A_i, and the best single-POVM classical Fisher trace is exactly k(Q). The output marginal SLDs are Phi(A_i), with QFI trace s_{Phi^2}(Q). On the positive-HS-spectrum class, the quantum marginal QFI loss is between one and two times the target Dirichlet loss. The new step is a common-POVM extraction theorem from the joint broadcast output.
opportunities.costs: The derivation uses no samples or selected seed ensemble; it is an analytic local-state model. The missing constant must be independent of d and frame rank. The proof must retain the tracial barycenter and permit only M_Q to depend on Q; the separated EB map must be common to every Q.
opportunities.historical_importance: If established, this would turn approximate preservation of a full local statistical model by a broadcaster into a common classical measurement and then a dimension-independent EB Dirichlet comparator. This is a potential mechanism, not a literature theorem or priority claim.
opportunities.strongest_primary_relation: Lu et al., Broadcasting Quantum Fisher Information, arXiv:1206.2821v3, lines 56-62: pointwise parameter-adapted measurement and uniformity criterion for infinite broadcast; Lemm-Wilde, arXiv:1608.07569v2, Theorem 4, lines 86-97, for a fixed state pair with one broadcast and one product-clone output.
opportunities.missing_lemma_for_ambitious_endpoint: A dimension-independent quantitative theorem producing one POVM for the entire weighted tangent frame from the symmetric joint output, at linear scale in the marginal Dirichlet loss.
compatibility_obligations: Use the exact tracial pure-ensemble barycenter I/d
one measurement handles every direction in the frame
M_Q may depend on Q but the final EB Psi cannot
only a local Fisher-information statement is needed
full HS spectrum can be reduced through Phi^2
opportunities.early_falsification_test: For d=2, optimize exact weighted Pauli frames under an exact symmetric qubit broadcaster and compare one joint multi-parameter POVM against the proposed linear-loss bound; the maximally mixed Pauli frame and universal 1-to-2 cloner give ratio 2 and are an exact sharp-C2 boundary check, not a proof.
opportunities.external_correctness: derived interface independently checked; missing lemma unproved

opportunities.exact_claim: A new consequence of the full legal broadcaster constraints would need to convert a frame-scale channel loss delta into common commuting/measurement approximants with total normalized-HS squared error O(delta), uniformly in matrix size and frame rank, and then prove these approximants define a unital TP EB channel.
opportunities.mechanism: Matrix-cube dilation gives one fixed abelian family but its optimal absolute operator-norm scale theta(d) grows as (sqrt(pi)/2)sqrt(d). Bansil-Kachkovskiy gives dimension-independent pair approximation in normalized HS norm with squared error O(commutator^(2/3)), sharp for its constraints; arbitrary N-tuples have C(N) and exponent 2/3^(N-1). Compatibility does not imply small commutators, as shown by jointly measurable noncommuting unsharp Pauli POVMs.
supplied_inputs: legal broadcaster B and marginal Phi
opportunities.costs: Known matrix-cube scale grows with d; pair HS rounding is dimension-independent but nonlinear in commutator, and stated multi-matrix constants/exponents depend on N. A full observable frame can have rank d^2-1.
opportunities.historical_importance: Clarifies why generic commuting-dilation and almost-commuting machinery does not currently imply the desired deficit comparison. No negative implication for the exact constrained target follows.
opportunities.strongest_primary_relation: Helton et al., arXiv:1412.1481v4, Theorem 1.1 and Proposition 13.3(3); Bansil-Kachkovskiy, arXiv:2608.31000v1, Theorems 1.1-1.3 and Corollary 1.4.
opportunities.missing_lemma_for_ambitious_endpoint: Derive normalized-HS commutator control at least O(delta^(3/2)) for each relevant pair (or a better direct rounding inequality), control a growing frame without C(N), and preserve linearity, positivity, trace/unitality, reference barycenter, and a common EB map.
compatibility_obligations: The theorem must use the supplied B, not arbitrary pairwise compatibility alone
the frame-wide measurement must be common
squared approximation error must be O(delta)
output must normalize to an EB channel
opportunities.early_falsification_test: Check whether any proposed implication from compatibility to small commutator survives the exact Pauli parent G_ab=(I+(a sigma_x+b sigma_z)/sqrt(2))/4; the marginals are compatible while their effect commutator has norm 1/4.
opportunities.external_correctness: primary theorem statements verified; proposed conversion unproved

opportunities.exact_claim: A common parent POVM for all images Phi(A) does not by itself imply that Phi is EB or yields an EB comparator with the desired Dirichlet deficit; a further fixed-state Born-response factorization is required.
opportunities.mechanism: Heinosaari-Kiukas-Reitzner-Schultz prove EB channels form a proper subclass of incompatibility-breaking channels. Their depolarizing examples can break incompatibility for every observable while remaining non-EB. A parent measurement provides arbitrary classical postprocessings, whereas EB requires postprocessings generated by fixed preparation states via Born probabilities.
opportunities.costs: Finite-n compatibility thresholds depend on n and dimension; universal compatibility still does not supply EB factorization. The exact target has stronger supplied-B and quadratic-loss constraints.
opportunities.historical_importance: Rules out replacing the required EB-channel construction by a generic joint-measurability argument, while leaving the full target open.
opportunities.strongest_primary_relation: Heinosaari et al., arXiv:1504.05768v2, Proposition 8; Section 4.2; Theorem 2.
opportunities.missing_lemma_for_ambitious_endpoint: A quantitative theorem converting legal selfcompatible channel constraints into fixed-state Born response functions while retaining the linear all-frame deficit bound.
compatibility_obligations: fixed preparation states across all observables
relative deficit rather than absolute error
opportunities.early_falsification_test: Use the white-noise depolarizing interval 1/(d+1)<t<=t0 from Theorem 2 as a control: the channel is IBC but not EB, so a proof that infers EB from a parent alone is false.
opportunities.external_correctness: source theorem verified; does not instantiate the exact target premises

rejected_transfers: Do not infer small commutators from joint measurability; the two unsharp Pauli POVMs above are a concrete jointly measurable noncommuting pair.
Do not apply Lemm-Wilde Theorem 4 to a generic supplied broadcaster: the theorem assumes a second input whose output is a product clone, while the legal premise guarantees equal marginals only.
Do not treat arbitrary pure-state ensembles as the k(Q) support; the exact state-model correspondence uses the I/d barycenter.
Do not treat the matrix-cube dilation scale as an EB deficit theorem; it is an optimal absolute operator-norm dilation constant growing like sqrt(d).
